He is NEVER a man wearing a golf cap. ObiWan Jacoby is the youthful sandy-blond human in the BROWN/OLIVE CLOAK and BEIGE layered tunic seen in the other reference, no championship belt. Only these two characters. Do not draw any other matchup or director.

Premium photoreal cinematic editorial page. Top moment: show Duckhook in a balanced powerful full-body golf driver follow-through, BOTH hands joined on ONE golf-club grip. Orange bill and duck identity unmistakable. Human ObiWan watches from the safe rear of the swing, on dry ground. No spectator in the projected flight path.

Middle moment: ObiWan rotates his torso through a sand-bunker recovery with flexed knees, TWO hands holding ONE golf club; believable sand fan and small released ball separated from the club. Duckhook observes behind him, outside swing arc and on dry ground. Cloak and tunic retain reference identity. Golf clubs only, not energy-sword swings or magic.

Keep white feathers/orange bill and youthful sandy-blond human features consistent across every moment.

Duckhook knew every ridge of his own course; ObiWan had returned with a memory the host would rather forget. A clean strike earned a glance. A ball in the rough earned silence. By the time they walked toward the green, the autumn light was still beautiful. Neither man was looking at it.
